purpose: Fresh observable non-parent canary for the active frontier. Prove the canonical ASTRA CLI starts from a real mission file, durably mark entry, then exercise autonomous PyPI acquisition so the first causal failure is preserved even if acquisition fails.
goal: Create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/MISSION_PATH_PYPI_CANARY_002_SOURCE.json containing exactly four records with fields id and text: 1 delta, 2 epsilon, 3 zeta, 4 eta. Using a Python library from PyPI discovered by the Brain, encode those exact records as CBOR and save canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/MISSION_PATH_PYPI_CANARY_002.cbor. Independently decode the CBOR artifact and verify the decoded records are exactly identical to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/MISSION_PATH_PYPI_CANARY_002_SOURCE.json in values, order, field names, and record count.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-RUNTIME-MISSION-PATH-PYPI-CANARY-CBOR-002__ENTRY.json')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(json.dumps({'schema':'PROJECT_BRAIN_MISSION_ENTRY_OBSERVATION_V1','mission_id':'ASTRA-RUNTIME-MISSION-PATH-PYPI-CANARY-CBOR-002','mission_path':'canonical/astra_runtime/missions/ASTRA_RUNTIME_MISSION_PATH_PYPI_CANARY_CBOR_002.json','entered_via':'canonical/runtime/astra_runtime.py'},indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('CANONICAL_MISSION_ENTRY_OBSERVED')
PY

constraints.acceptance: Entry observation must persist; origin mission path must be canonical and non-empty; APT_ORIGIN_MISSION_PATH_INVALID and PYPI_ORIGIN_MISSION_PATH_INVALID are forbidden terminal causes.
